headline: What Is STCO? TSMC's New Semiconductor Division Strategy: Bringing Suppliers Into Bases, Challenging the "20 People, 21 Legs" | Finance
summary: At an international semiconductor exhibition, TSMC introduced System Technology Co-Optimization (STCO) to address advanced packaging challenges. Taiwanese suppliers see it as an opportunity.
why: TSMC is the world's largest contract chipmaker, so its packaging and design strategies shape demand for materials and equipment suppliers across the chip supply chain.
